text:
alex: heads-up, eval pipeline alerted on a QA-EM regression for q8-llama-compat builds. ~6% drop on primary suite since yesterday's deploy. anyone see local failures?
marie: i see failures too. runner logs show repeated 'timeout fetching kv shard' entries during decode for longer sequences. snippet: 
```
runner_worker.py: timeout fetching kv shard for model=llama-compat-q8 shard=2
Traceback (most recent call last): socket.timeout
```
sahil: repro'd higher tail latency with seq_len > 512 on q8 artifacts. looks like a change in attention path scheduling.
priya: which PR landed last night touching kernel selection? i thought we only had refactors.
alex: PR #2147 (auto-kernel-selector refactor) modified fallback heuristics and added fused-attn preference for q8. might be related.
jen: propose quick bisect: revert kernel-selector change in a canary branch and run lightweight eval to see if pass rate returns.
deploy-bot: (system) queued: eval-suite/lightweight on branch canary/revert-kernel (build 1780110001)
marie: also seeing rerank score distribution shift on quantized runs. tiny numeric differences are changing tie-breaks, so ordering flips on borderline cases.
sahil: triage plan: 1) reproduce with native vs q8 locally 2) force legacy kernels to isolate patch 3) per-example diff to find where answers change
alex: ran per-example diffs vs baseline: ~2100 examples with EM drop. failures concentrate on longer answers and multi-sentence completions, not tokenization.
priya: i can force legacy kernels via FORCED_KERNEL=legacy_attn and run overnight on the lightweight set.
jen: if canary-revert fixes it, block the merge and open a follow-up PR to rework fallback logic. this is a release blocker for current model onboardings.
sahil: note: runner CI showed intermittent worker restarts alongside timeouts. possible memory growth when fused-attn handles q8 KV caches.
alex: can we get heap/alloc profiles attached to the CI job? eng-infra, can you instrument the canary run?
eng-infra: yes, we can enable jemalloc profiling and CPU flamegraphs for build 1780110001. need approval and a reproducible failing job id.
marie: dashboard action: add short-term alert for 'pct inference > 500ms' on eval dashboard to catch tail regressions early. low-effort and useful.
priya: quick update: forced-legacy run finished; lightweight pass rate back to baseline. looks like the kernel-selector change introduced the regression.
alex: summary and action items: 1) rollback kernel-selector PR on master (blocker) 2) add unit + perf smoke tests for kernel selection 3) add nightly quantized-long-seq CI job to catch this earlier
jen: i'll open the rollback PR and mark it urgent. @sahil @priya please validate rollback doesn't reintroduce old perf cliffs.
sahil: will validate and add a synthetic long-seq test to runner CI to trigger fused-attn paths.
priya: i'll open a follow-up issue with root-cause notes, proposed heuristics for fallback, and memory-safety guards for fused-attn.
alex: asking for decision by EOD since multiple customers are blocked.
jen: rollback PR created: #2193 reverting auto-kernel-selector refactor. CI running now.
marie: post-rollback, run the full eval-suite against the quantized release candidate before we re-merge the refactor.
alex: thanks team. adding a line to eval runbook: kernel selection is a critical regression vector; include perf smoke in PR checklist.
jen: agreed. will link the rollback PR here after CI finishes.
deploy-bot: (system) CI update: build 1780110001 instrumented with jemalloc profiling. logs attached to job.
eng-infra: attached heap profiles to the CI artifacts. initial look shows increased resident set for fused-attn in q8 path. saving profiles to infra ticket.
marie: next ops: once rollback passes, schedule controlled re-rollout with A/B canary and memory telemetry.
alex: perfect. good triage and fast loop. thanks everyone.
